page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-72-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 72 dedicated vCPUs and 576.0 GB of RAM. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, positioning it within the memory-optimized category. The instance utilizes ARM architecture and includes NVMe SSD local storage, though it does not feature any GPU accelerators.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. With 576.0 GB of memory, the instance is designed to handle memory-intensive workloads efficiently. The qualitative cost profile of this ARM-based architecture typically offers high resource density and power efficiency compared to traditional x86 architectures, making it a viable option for deployments requiring substantial memory capacity per core.

This server type is suited for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and data processing pipelines that benefit from high memory capacity and local NVMe SSD storage. The lack of GPU acceleration makes it unsuitable for heavy machine learning training, but the 72 dedicated arm64 vCPUs provide ample compute power for parallelized enterprise workloads and web serving at scale.
